title: Ole the Tower-Keeper

full_text:
High atop the church tower in Copenhagen lived Ole, the old watchman. Looking down upon the bustling city below, he watched kings and beggars, processions and funerals, like swarming ants upon a hill.

"Down there," chuckled Ole, "people fret and scheme for gold and ribbons that vanish like smoke! Up here among the clouds and stars, one breathes pure air and listens to the eternal music of the spheres."

His pipe smoke curled into the sunset, carrying the quiet wisdom of a man who lived above the illusions of the crowd.
moral: Looking down from the tower of contemplation reveals the folly of petty worldly ambition.
